comments.regular: Oblivion Script_CommandList: 369 contiguous CommandInfo records, 0x28 bytes each, opcodes 0x1000..0x1170. ConditionEntry::Data.functionIndex directly selects a row; ConditionItem_Evaluate consumes its eval/needsParent metadata, not its separate script execute wrapper. There are 169 nonnull eval callbacks, 114 with needsParent=1. A streaming scan of vanilla Oblivion.esm found 25,287 CTDA/CTDT entries across INFO children of GREETING C8, HELLO D2, GOODBYE D4, and INFOGENERAL D7. Most used: GetIsID 9,361; GetStage 5,690; GetInFaction 2,365; GetIsRace 1,650; GetQuestVariable 962; GetDisposition 804; GetTalkedToPC 540; GetDeadCount 407; GetRandomPercent 381; GetStageDone 341; GetGlobalValue 203; GetIsCurrentPackage 201. These are authored condition-row counts, not runtime execution counts.

confidence_scope: Raw live IDA annotation; bulk synchronization does not independently verify semantic names or comments.
